approvalSource: User request to repair the collection issues shown in the supplied Shopify screenshots, create one common Footwear collection with all human footwear, create Rings, Necklaces, Bracelets, Earrings, and Everyday Jewelry collections, add School Bags, Lunch Boxes, and Water Bottles, rework Back to School and Stationery, verify wrong-product exclusions including pet products in human collections, verify exact live price collection membership, and wire the verified rules into the release workflow

scope.managedCollections: create or repair only canonical collections in the checked-in full-catalog governance registry
scope.controlledRuleTags: exactly one canonical simple collection tag condition per semantic collection, except approved union rules for gifts and trending-finds
scope.existingTags: preserve unmanaged tags exactly; exact-replace checked-in canonical managed tags
scope.onlineStorePublication: publish newly created canonical collections to Online Store; preserve existing publication state
scope.legacyHandleRedirects: redirect only explicitly checked-in legacy handles when reusing their collection record
scope.priceCollections: repair exact variant-price conditions and verify exact live membership
scope.collectionlessProducts: forbidden; every active product must be verified in at least one live collection
scope.specialCollections: Creator Essentials must contain at least 500 products and Anime Collectables at least 1000 products across the full catalog
scope.footwearCollections: Footwear, Mens Footwear, Formal Footwear, Womens Footwear, and Kids Footwear use exact governed tags with verified human-footwear evidence; pet footwear and footwear accessories are excluded
scope.jewelryCollections: Rings, Necklaces, Bracelets, Earrings, and Everyday Jewelry use exact governed tags with jewelry department and subtype evidence; Everyday Jewelry is the broad jewelry collection
scope.schoolCollections: School Bags require school or student context plus bag evidence; Lunch Boxes require lunch-container evidence and exclude bags, labels, notes, and accessories; Water Bottles require beverage-container evidence and exclude pets, hot-water bottles, parts, holders, and accessories
scope.schoolSeasonalCollections: Back to School requires school context plus a school-product signal; Stationery requires an office-school department and an approved stationery subcategory
